articles.title: Ilia Topuria Wants Justin Gaethje, NOW!
articles.description: Ilia Topuria wants an immediate rematch with Justin Gaethje, and Chael Sonnen doesn't understand the resistance. Topuria was an undefeated champion and the favorite before Gaethje pulled off the upset. With the rest of the lightweight division still sorting itself out, Chael believes Topuria remains one of the most logical options for Gaethje's next title defense. Gaethje has publicly said he doesn't want rematches. He wants new names and new experiences before his career ends. But Chael doesn't believe that means Gaethje would actually turn Topuria down if the UFC made the call. Arman Tsarukyan and Mauricio Ruffy still have business to settle. Usman Nurmagomedov isn't in the UFC yet. Max Holloway and Charles Oliveira have their own complications. Start eliminating the alternatives, and Chael keeps coming back to the same name. Ilia Topuria wants Justin Gaethje again. The fans want it. And so does Chael. articles.title: Why did Usman turn down $2 million? #ufc
articles.description: Why would Kamaru Usman turn down a $2 million offer from the PFL? Chael Sonnen says that decision raises some serious questions. Chael breaks down Usman’s situation and explains why the UFC’s current “offer” may actually be silence. Is Usman betting on a bigger opportunity, or is money simply not the priority? For Chael, there’s another factor that can completely change the equation: the fight itself. A rivalry, a grudge, a social-media feud, or one heated exchange can be worth more than millions of dollars when it creates a fight people actually want to see. So what is Usman waiting for — and does the UFC have the right fight for him? #UFC #MMA #KamaruUsman #ChaelSonnen #PFL #UFCNews #MMAnews

articles.title: Ilia Topuria Is Ready to Fight!
articles.description: Ilia Topuria is ready to fight again, and Chael Sonnen believes the lightweight title picture is beginning to point toward a rematch with Justin Gaethje. Gaethje has said he doesn't want another rematch and may not compete again until 2027. But Dana White recently made it clear that he believes Gaethje still has plenty of fights and money left on the table. That creates a problem. Topuria isn't the only elite lightweight Gaethje has already faced. Max Holloway and Charles Oliveira have beaten him as well. If Gaethje remains champion, Chael argues that simply refusing rematches can't prevent legitimate contenders from earning title opportunities. And if Topuria competes again and wins, Chael believes his position becomes especially difficult to deny There are still other possibilities, including the winner of Arman Tsarukyan vs. Mauricio Ruffy. But after listening to Gaethje, Topuria and Dana White, Chael sees the wind blowing in one direction: Justin Gaethje vs. Ilia Topuria, Part 2. articles.title: Tommy Gunn's Hotel Confrontation
articles.description: Tommy Gunn ran into his UFC Noche opponent at the fighter hotel, and things quickly got uncomfortable. What started as a conversation turned into both fighters refusing to give ground. Tommy didn't want his opponent anywhere near him. His opponent couldn't understand why Tommy was reacting that way. Eventually, they let each other get close enough that Chael Sonnen believes they broke one of the most important rules of a confrontation outside the Octagon. If someone with bad intentions gets within range, the situation has already changed. But Chael noticed something else while watching the video: everyone had their phones out, everyone was watching, and Tommy had an entourage around him. What he didn't have was the one person every fighter needs in exactly this situation. articles.title: You Have No Idea How Big Islam Is in Russia
articles.description: Chael Sonnen just returned from Russia with Real American Freestyle, and some of the most memorable moments had nothing to do with what happened in competition. Chael wanted to understand how Russians view their combat sports legends. Alexander Karelin is one of the greatest wrestlers ever. Fedor Emelianenko became an MMA icon. But when Chael asked a Russian about Khabib Nurmagomedov, the reaction was completely different. Then there was Khamzat Chimaev honoring wrestling legend Buvaisar Saitiev after his match, and Islam Makhachev creating such a scene that simply moving him through the building required armed security. Yet Islam still stopped for fans, kids and photographs as he was being escorted out. Chael saw firsthand how these fighters are received when they return to Russia and what wrestling and fighting mean within that culture. And before the night ended, Jordan Burroughs called out Islam Makhachev, bringing an old challenge back to life. articles.title: Ilia vs. Gaethje 2 Is the RIGHT Fight #ufc
articles.description: Does Ilia Topuria really need to rebuild his way back to the UFC title? Chael Sonnen says absolutely not. Ilia was an undefeated champion, a heavy favorite, and one of the biggest stars in the UFC when Justin Gaethje handed him the upset loss. Now the question is whether Ilia should fight his way back up the division — or immediately get another shot at the belt. Chael argues that Ilia vs. Gaethje 2 isn't just a good idea. It's the right idea. And there's another problem with making Ilia “rebuild”: the possible opponents waiting for him have already proven themselves against the current champion. Chael explains why putting Ilia against a lesser-ranked opponent could actually create an even more dangerous fight. Should Ilia get an immediate rematch with Justin Gaethje? Or does he need to earn his way back? #UFC #MMA #IliaTopuria #JustinGaethje #ChaelSonnen #UFCNews #UFCRematch

articles.title: Give Ilia Topuria his REMATCH #ufc
articles.description: Was Ilia Topuria vs. Justin Gaethje really one-sided? Chael Sonnen says absolutely not — and he explains why an immediate rematch might make more sense than people think. Chael breaks down the war between Ilia Topuria and Justin Gaethje, pushing back on the idea that Gaethje simply dominated the UFC champion. Yes, Gaethje hurt Ilia badly, changed his face, attacked the body and appeared to break his rib — but Chael argues that the fight was far more competitive than the final result suggests. He also addresses Luke Thomas’ reaction to the possibility of Ilia vs. Gaethje 2 and explains why an undefeated champion losing a back-and-forth battle doesn't automatically make a rematch a bad idea. Was Gaethje’s performance enough to demand a second fight? Or should Ilia move on? Watch Chael’s full take and decide for yourself. #UFC #MMA #IliaTopuria #JustinGaethje #ChaelSonnen #UFCRematch #UFCNews

articles.title: Ian Garry Thinks Prates Can Beat Islam
articles.description: Ian Machado Garry has now shared an opinion Chael Sonnen didn't expect: Carlos Prates could beat Islam Makhachev. What makes the prediction particularly interesting is that Garry has firsthand experience with both men. He's spent significant time competing against Prates and Islam, giving him a perspective very few fighters have. But Chael is trying to figure out what Garry actually means. Is this simply an old fighter tactic? Beat one guy, then tell everyone that guy could beat the champion, indirectly making your own victory look even better? Or is Garry giving an honest technical assessment after experiencing both fighters firsthand? That's especially confusing to Chael after watching Garry show Islam enormous respect during and immediately after their title fight. If Garry genuinely believes Prates presents a better matchup, Chael wants to hear why. He felt both men. His opinion matters. So is Ian Garry playing the game, or does he sincerely believe Carlos Prates can beat Islam Makhachev? articles.title: Why Chael Sonnen Doesn't Hate Tito Ortiz Anymore #ufc
articles.description: Sometimes the words hit harder than anything that happens inside the cage. Chael Sonnen tells the story of a moment when someone looked him in the eyes and said, “I hate you.” At first, Chael didn’t feel the same way. In fact, he remembers thinking that this was the worst thing the other person could possibly say to him. But then Chael answered. And the response was about as direct as it gets. “I fucking hate you.” This is one of those moments where the story says more about competition, emotion, and rivalry than any fight statistic ever could. #ChaelSonnen #MMA #UFC #MMAStories #UFCStories #Fighting #MMAFighting

articles.title: Ian Garry Just Screwed Michael Morales
articles.description: Michael Morales appears to be in position for a title fight with Islam Makhachev, but Chael Sonnen believes Ian Machado Garry may have just changed everything without throwing a punch. Garry publicly called for a fight with Morales. Morales hasn't responded. And according to Chael, that's exactly the problem. At the same time, Prates is actively making his case for the title opportunity while Morales has done surprisingly little publicly to secure his position. If Garry's challenge becomes accepted as the obvious next fight for Morales, Prates could suddenly be the last man standing for Islam. Chael compares it to previous UFC title races where one contender effectively removed both himself and a rival by calling for a fight, leaving someone else alone at the front of the line. Morales may still get Islam next. But until the bout agreement is signed, Chael argues his team cannot allow someone else to control the narrative. Ian Garry called him out. Now Michael Morales has a problem.
